["table","client_command_identities","client_command_identities",215,"CREATE TABLE client_command_identities (
 principal TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES auth_principals(id),
 command_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(command_id)>0),
 protocol TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(protocol='researchos-client/2'),
 project TEXT NOT NULL,
 method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(method)>0),
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation='v2:'||method),
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(request_hash)=71 AND substr(request_hash,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(request_hash,8) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(created_at)>0),
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,command_id),
 UNIQUE(principal,command_id,request_hash),
 FOREIGN KEY(principal,project,operation,command_id,request_hash)
  REFERENCES idempotency(principal,project,operation,key,request_hash)
  DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
)"]

["table","client_command_queue","client_command_queue",203,"CREATE TABLE client_command_queue (

 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_receipt_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(principal,project,command_id), UNIQUE(generation,queue_sequence)
)"]

)"]

["table","client_sessions","client_sessions",227,"CREATE TABLE client_sessions (
  id                            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,

  updated_at                    TEXT NOT NULL,
  goal_id                       TEXT,
  task_id                       TEXT,
  run_id                        TEXT,
  writer_epoch                  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (writer_epoch >= 1),
  writer_client_id              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(writer_client_id) >= 1),
  lease_expires_at              TEXT,
  event_watermark               INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (event_watermark >= 0),
  upstream_session_id           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(upstream_session_id) >= 1),
  upstream_log_id               TEXT,

  workspace_ref                 TEXT,
  title                         TEXT,
  model_config_ref              TEXT,
  core_build_id                 TEXT,
  transcript_artifact_id        TEXT,
  resume_requires_explicit_user INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (resume_requires_explicit_user IN (0,1)),
  sealed_at                     TEXT,
  archived_at                   TEXT,
  protocol                      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'researchos-client/2' CHECK (protocol = 'researchos-client/2')
)"]

["table","evolution_release_operations","evolution_release_operations",183,"CREATE TABLE evolution_release_operations (
  project TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('START_CANARY','ROLLBACK','PROMOTE')),
  operation_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  expected_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(expected_epoch)='integer' AND expected_epoch > 0),
  admission_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(admission_hash)=64 AND admission_hash NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  effect_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PREPARED','DISPATCHED','OBSERVED','FAILED','PROJECTED')),
  receipt_digest TEXT,
  projection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (typeof(projection_revision)='integer' AND projection_revision >= 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (project,candidate,action),
  CHECK ((status IN ('OBSERVED','PROJECTED') AND receipt_digest IS NOT NULL AND length(receipt_digest)=64 AND receipt_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*') OR
         (status IN ('PREPARED','DISPATCHED','FAILED') AND receipt_digest IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((status='PROJECTED' AND projection_revision>0) OR (status!='PROJECTED' AND projection_revision=0))
)"]

["trigger","research_work_update","research_cycle_work",0,"CREATE TRIGGER research_work_update BEFORE UPDATE ON research_cycle_work BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.project IS NOT OLD.project OR NEW.cycle IS NOT OLD.cycle OR NEW.logical_key IS NOT OLD.logical_key OR NEW.plan_ref IS NOT OLD.plan_ref OR NEW.stage IS NOT OLD.stage OR NEW.task IS NOT OLD.task OR NEW.experiment IS NOT OLD.experiment OR NEW.source_id IS NOT OLD.source_id OR NEW.evidence_id IS NOT OLD.evidence_id OR NEW.input_refs IS NOT OLD.input_refs OR NEW.input_hash IS NOT OLD.input_hash OR NEW.parameters IS NOT OLD.parameters OR NEW.window_from IS NOT OLD.window_from OR NEW.window_to IS NOT OLD.window_to OR NEW.progress_record_id IS NOT OLD.progress_record_id OR NEW.created_at IS NOT OLD.created_at
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable research work mapping') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND NEW.source_receipt IS NOT OLD.source_receipt
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'immutable source receipt') END;
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.source_receipt IS NOT NULL AND (
 json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch') IS NOT 'integer' OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.epoch')<1
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.project_id') IS NOT NEW.project
 OR json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.task_id') IS NOT NEW.task
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.effect_key') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.request_hash') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id') IS NOT 'text'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.manifest_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_before_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR json_type(NEW.source_receipt,'$.cursor_after_ref') IS NOT 'object'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='Run' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.run_id') AND json_extract(body,'$.task_id')=NEW.task)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM domain_objects WHERE project=NEW.project AND kind='BudgetLedgerEntry' AND id=json_extract(NEW.source_receipt,'$.reservation_id')))
 THEN RAISE(ABORT,'bound source receipt required') END;
END"]
